mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE banned_until >= #{today}
SELECT s.student_no, s.name, s.violation_count, s.banned_until FROM student s WHERE s.violation_count > 0 ORDER BY s.violation_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.room_id, sr.name AS room_name, COUNT(*) AS total_reservations, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, r.actual_sign_time, r.actual_leave_time)) AS avg_usage_min FROM reservation r JOIN study_room sr ON r.room_id = sr.id WHERE r.reserve_date = #{date} AND r.status = 3 GROUP BY r.room_id, sr.name
